title: Surgical Site Infections: A Comprehensive Review
content: Surgical site infections are an important public health problem leading to increased morbidity and mortality and healthcare costs across the globe. The paper provides a systematic review of the epidemiology, classification, risk factors, microbiological aspects, treatment modalities, and prevention strategies of surgical site infections based on contemporary research and evidence-based practice protocols. Some of the more salient global concerns identified by surgical site infections have been antibiotic resistance and the contamination of surgical instruments, especially in resource-poor settings. These reports underscore the importance of preventive measures, such as appropriate preoperative interventions, strict use of aseptic technique, and appropriate antibiotic prophylaxis, in making the incidence of SSIs and patient outcomes improve better.
